title: Yummy Zesty Polish Potato Skewers
description: Spicy crunchy skewers baked in a wood fire style using sunflower oil, perfect for a quick lunch or hangover cure.
instructions: Preheat a wood fire oven or grill to medium high heat (about 400F).
Toss the cut potatoes in a bowl with sunflower oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, cayenne pepper, and salt until evenly coated.
Thread the seasoned potatoes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a sheet or on the grill and bake or grill for 12 to 15 minutes, turning occasionally, until the edges are crisp.
While the potatoes cook, zest the lemon and squeeze a tablespoon of fresh lemon juice.
Once done, remove the skewers from the heat and let them cool for a few minutes.
Drizzle the lemon zest, lemon juice, and chopped parsley over the hot skewers.
Give everything a gentle toss to combine the flavors.
Serve immediately hot for maximum crunch, optionally with a side of yogurt dip for added protein.
